source.evidence_kind: Pinned public OMP source and its recorded Antigravity Hub observations; not an independently documented official CLI protocol or proof of account compatibility.

identity.evidence: Version pinned from the official 2026-10-21 Hub manifest using the unchanged reviewed OMP constructor. The darwin/arm64 identity and cl=963137146 remain the constructor constants, not a new native-client traffic capture; the artifact build locator is not treated as a changelist.

authentication.authority: Independent router-owned Google OAuth consent and refresh lifecycle
authentication.registration_provenance: Reviewed installed-application registration in the pinned public OMP source, selected explicitly by the operator; operator-owned environment registration is also supported.
authentication.legacy_state_volume: Preserved for explicit rollback; never opened by the direct adapter
authentication.dispatch_barrier: Private shared cross-process dispatch lock is held through response headers; restrictions publish durable closing intent before exclusive drain. A completed closure returns only after previously admitted header dispatches drain; already-transmitted requests may have reached the provider.

registration.packaging: Base64-encoded public installed-app registration matching the pinned OMP source; not encryption and not personal user tokens
registration.runtime_verification: Compiled baseline checks decoded registration fingerprints; saved session client ID must match configuration before authenticated traffic, including unexpired tokens. Metadata drift never auto-updates registration.

authentication.baseline_upgrade: A stored prior baseline remains blocked until the operator explicitly runs agy resume with the gateway stopped. Resume preserves the matching OAuth session and rotates its generation; no automatic state migration or new consent is performed.

request_contract.session_id_shape: Negative decimal 63-bit value encoded as a string, derived stably from first user text and scoped to owner, exact model and account generation; bounded negative random fallback without a nonempty first user turn.
request_contract.history: Typed chronological user/model parts; leading system/developer instructions become systemInstruction parts. Mid-conversation system/developer changes are rejected rather than reordered.
request_contract.tool_schema: CCA-compatible legacy parameters hints: resolve local refs and project supported types, properties, items, required and string enums; full original schema is retained in descriptions and enforced locally before any client handoff. Provider hints do not enforce every JSON Schema constraint.
request_contract.tool_mode: VALIDATED when tools are supplied, and for Claude even without tools
request_contract.tool_results: Complete contiguous groups matched by original client ID and reordered to original call order. Claude retains function-part IDs; Gemini omits them according to its CCA contract.
request_contract.tool_choice_none: Omit the complete wire tool inventory and reject any unexpected returned call
request_contract.response_schema: Preserve full JSON Schema in model instructions; withhold provisional public output and validate the completed JSON locally
request_contract.effort: Preserve exact raw model ID; reject an explicit effort conflicting with its suffix. Do not invent numeric budgets or fixed wire caps for these IDs.
request_contract.claude_thinking_header: anthropic-beta: interleaved-thinking-2025-05-14 on generation for the six reviewed Claude 5.5 tier IDs only
request_contract.session_continuation_validation: Stable scoped negative-decimal session IDs, canonical function-call parts and explicit private-state requests follow reviewed source behavior. The decisive live Claude continuation fix was omitting standalone empty visible text/signature parts; no endpoint or identity update was needed.
request_contract.claude_private_thought_state: For the six reviewed Claude 5.5 tier IDs, generationConfig.thinkingConfig.includeThoughts is true to receive private thought/signature replay state. No numeric thinking budget, level override, or hard output cap is inferred.
request_contract.request_type: Omitted, matching the reviewed upstream removal of requestType:agent.

response_contract.envelope: SSE JSON data frames containing response or a sanitized in-band error
response_contract.text_policy: Visible text preserved verbatim; no Flash JSON removal or thinking-fence healing
response_contract.private_thoughts: thought:true is private; thoughtSignature alone never makes visible text private. Reassemble typed blocks; Claude unsigned private blocks are omitted only from wire replay.
response_contract.terminal_success: STOP with visible text or complete validated client tools
response_contract.terminal_incomplete: MAX_TOKENS, with no client tool handoff or private replay publication
response_contract.invalid_terminal: Missing, duplicate, conflicting, safety/error, malformed-call and unsupported finishes fail the generation
response_contract.tool_handoff: Complete object arguments validated against current client tools only after a successful terminal
response_contract.usage: Input includes cached input; output includes candidates plus reasoning. Cached and reasoning details are subsets, not additional totals. Missing or inferred usage is explicitly partial.
response_contract.function_call_replay: Canonical functionCall part plus optional nonempty thoughtSignature only; omit upstream empty text/default thought fields to avoid conflicting oneof payloads.

live_empty_text_regression.case: Chat client-tool handoff and result continuation succeeded after omitting standalone empty visible replay parts.
live_empty_text_regression.scope: Correctness evidence for the reviewed local Claude continuation regression only. Exact model/revision acceptance is recorded separately in docs/validation.md; no matched performance claim is made.

bounds.original_absolute_deadline: Carried through dispatch and streaming; no generation retry resets it

private_replay.storage: Bounded process memory only; never public output items, logs, telemetry or durable state
scope: full public history prefix and instruction anchor
public assistant text and complete tool calls
private_replay.canonical_anchor: SHA-256 of public wire contents and system instruction parts, excluding private thoughts/signatures and wire function IDs
private_replay.cross_api: Canonical public turns permit Chat Completions to Responses continuation
limitations: Replay expires on restart, TTL or eviction and cannot cross account generations or models
Client-provided foreign reasoning is not accepted as Antigravity private replay
Missing replay never imports another process's credentials or private reasoning
private_replay.empty_visible_parts: Standalone empty visible text/signature parts remain private cache metadata and are omitted from wire replay; nonempty visible text and typed signature-only empty thoughts are retained.

release_advisory.changed_failed_or_stale_metadata: Advisory alerts only; never close auth gates, mutate identity or determine readiness

validation_scope: Synthetic fixtures establish agreement with this baseline; actual Google authorization, project availability, model behavior and matched performance remain separate live acceptance evidence.
